$Comment: What the Yeti's daily Claim (Rewards/Christmas/Christmas_Yeti_Daily) pays, the bigger Claim, for the
first win each day. Every roll is read on its own: the first two always pay, the last is a chance on
top. The Claim keeps each roll a player wins with a chance equal to their share of the fight.
The first roll pays Christmas Coins and festival tokens through the Currency reward kind, the second a
Hot Cocoa (the warm drink that takes the edge off the cold), and the last a chance at two Gingerbread
Cookies. Favor is not here: the cave's clear pays Santa's Nice List (Christmas_Yeti_Cave_Clear).
Mmo_Christmas_Yeti_Daily.json adds Defense XP where MMO Skill Tree runs. Chance is a percent from 0
to 100. A companion mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in ContributesTo.
Name: Christmas_Yeti_Daily
